hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Find the longest sequential prefix where each element nums[i] == nums[i - 1] + 1.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Compute the sum of this sequential prefix.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Store nums in a hash set. Starting from the prefix sum, increment by 1 until finding a value not present in the set.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of input array nums
complexity.notes: Linear scan for sequential prefix sum followed by set membership lookups.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated linear searches take O(n^2) instead of O(n) with a hash set.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary hash set for O(1) membership checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify prefix condition stopping at first non-consecutive element.
